plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("marketing science" OR "quantitative marketing" OR "consumer behavior") AND (pricing OR promotion OR advertising OR conversion)
queries.rationale: This broad anchor captures the main empirical marketing literature while biasing toward commercially actionable topics rather than general theory.

queries.query: ("price ending" OR "charm pricing" OR ".99 pricing" OR "nine-ending prices" OR "psychological pricing") AND (retail OR ecommerce OR consumer)
queries.rationale: This targets evidence on whether and when charm pricing affects purchase behavior, demand, and perception in modern retail settings.

queries.query: (discount OR promotion OR coupon OR markdown) AND ("brand equity" OR "brand image" OR "willingness to pay" OR profitability)
queries.rationale: This isolates research on the downside risk of promotions, including brand dilution, margin effects, and long-run willingness to pay.

queries.query: ("advertising effectiveness" OR "ad effectiveness" OR "creative effectiveness" OR "ad creative") AND (click-through OR conversion OR sales OR purchase)
queries.rationale: This catches empirical work linking creative characteristics to hard outcomes such as clicks, purchases, and sales lift.

queries.query: ("copywriting" OR "advertising copy" OR slogan OR headline OR messaging) AND (persuasion OR conversion OR sales OR choice)
queries.rationale: This retrieves studies on how wording, claims, and message framing affect persuasion and conversion beyond visual creative alone.

queries.query: ("product name" OR branding OR "brand name" OR naming OR "product naming") AND (choice OR preference OR purchase OR recall)
queries.rationale: This focuses on research about how names influence memorability, perceived fit, preference, and purchase behavior.

queries.query: (scarcity OR urgency OR limited-time OR "limited quantity" OR countdown) AND (purchase OR checkout OR conversion OR demand)
queries.rationale: This targets evidence on whether scarcity and urgency signals move buyers at checkout or in shopping contexts.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR nudge OR nudging OR defaults OR framing) AND (consumer OR ecommerce OR purchase OR conversion)
queries.rationale: This captures behavioral interventions that can alter shopping choices, take-up, and conversion without changing the core offer.

queries.query: ("A/B test" OR experimentation OR "field experiment" OR randomized) AND (advertising OR pricing OR promotion OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: This is tuned for papers with stronger identification and practical test designs directly relevant to growth experimentation.

queries.query: (personalization OR targeting OR recommendation OR segmentation) AND (conversion OR purchase OR sales OR response)
queries.rationale: This covers when tailored offers, messages, or recommendations improve response and when they may backfire.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR website OR "product page" OR "online storefront") AND (conversion OR persuasion OR trust OR purchase)
queries.rationale: This catches work on page design and content features that affect trust, persuasion, and conversion on ecommerce surfaces.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR reviews OR ratings OR testimonials OR popularity) AND (purchase OR conversion OR sales OR trust)
queries.rationale: This isolates evidence on reviews, ratings, and popularity signals as levers for conversion and trust.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR shipping fee OR delivery OR "shipping threshold") AND (purchase OR cart OR conversion OR demand)
queries.rationale: This targets a major DTC lever by capturing how shipping charges, thresholds, and delivery promises affect purchase decisions.

queries.query: ("price promotion" OR coupon OR rebate OR bundle OR markdown) AND (elasticity OR demand OR sales OR stockpiling)
queries.rationale: This retrieves quantitative work on how specific promotion formats change demand, timing, and category behavior.

queries.query: (framing OR "gain frame" OR "loss frame" OR "message framing") AND (consumer OR advertising OR purchase OR conversion)
queries.rationale: This captures a distinct persuasion mechanism relevant to offers, claims, and checkout messaging.

queries.query: ("willingness to pay" OR valuation OR price sensitivity OR elasticity) AND (consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR brand)
queries.angle: price sensitivity and willingness to pay
queries.rationale: This anchors the pricing side of the plan in outcome measures useful for deciding when higher prices, discounts, or premium positioning work.

plan.coverage_notes: The plan emphasizes actionable, empirical marketing topics most relevant to a DTC growth marketer: pricing, promotions, ad creative, onsite conversion, naming, nudges, social proof, and shipping economics. It includes a dedicated causal-evidence query to surface field experiments and A/B-style studies, while avoiding broad media theory, marketing history, and brand scholarship detached from measurable outcomes. I assumed the reader wants papers that can inform tests and decisions in ecommerce environments, so several queries are explicitly scoped to retail, ecommerce, checkout, conversion, and sales.
